ga4.title: GA4 Visitor Sync
ga4.description: Pulls daily visitors from the GA4 property connected to the three imweb sites every day at 04:00 and feeds the Dashboard Marketing · Visitor metric. Manual input wins on days where it exists.
ga4.setupHint: Prerequisites: ① create a GA4 property with one web data stream per site ② connect the measurement ID in imweb Settings › Marketing channels › Google Analytics ③ enable the Google Analytics Data API in GCP and issue a service-account JSON key ④ add the service-account email as Viewer under GA4 property access management.

propertyId.label: GA4 property ID
propertyId.hint: Numeric ID from GA4 Admin › Property settings (not the G-… measurement ID)

streamMap.label: Data stream ID per site
streamMap.hint: Numeric stream ID from GA4 Admin › Data streams. Leave empty to skip a site.

saKey.label: Service-account key (JSON)
saKey.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Choose a file only to replace it.
saKey.pastePlaceholder: …or paste the JSON file contents here ({"type":"service_account", ...})
saKey.pasteHint: If choosing a file is inconvenient, paste the JSON contents instead. It is encrypted on save exactly like a file.
